text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout: model-router v2.10.0 -> prod (canary 21:45 UTC, ramp 22:10).
incident-bot: New incident INC-8240: eu-west kv-sweeper compaction failures, elevated error rate.
alexa: fyi ops asking to stop any releases that touch kv-sweeper compaction codepaths.
tom: we have a small change in v2.10 that toggles compaction_delay default.
sarah: is the failure causing tombstones or just GC pauses?
ops_lead: seeing tombstone churn during compaction -> some writes returning 5xx. request immediate hold for compaction-related deploys.
alexa: @deploybot pause rollout model-router v2.10.0 and pin slot to v2.9.8.
deploybot: Command accepted: `pause rollout model-router v2.10.0` — rollout paused. Slot pinned to v2.9.8. Auto-promote disabled.
tom: noted. preparing rollback snippet: `deploybot promote model-router v2.9.8 --force --reason "INC-8240 kv-sweeper"`.
sarah: putting release notes publish on hold and marking release as quarantined in internal drafts.
ops_lead: short triage: compaction thread pool OOMing, working a mitigation to reduce compaction concurrency and disable sweeper on eu cluster. testing now (non-prod). ETA 25m.
alexa: if mitigation clears tests, can we do a micro-canary in 60m? small traffic slice only.
tom: yes — plan: 2% canary -> 10% -> ramp. will add circuit breaker thresholds.
sarah: please also hold the change window notice to customers until we confirm.
alexa: moving change window tentatively from 21:45 -> 03:00 UTC pending triage. will update calendar.
incident-bot: INC-8240 updated: investigation ongoing (tags: kv-sweeper, eu-west, high).
deploybot: Reminder: pinned slot blocks scheduled promotions. To unpin run `deploybot unpin model-router`.
ops_lead: if we need to rollback, do it quickly and then run data-verify job `kv-verify --region eu-west` after.
tom: adding the rollback and verify steps to runbook now.
alexa: ok team, next update in 20m or on status change. keep convo here unless customer impact. :hourglass:
sarah: :thumbsup:
